newsitem.title: USA: Chelsea Clinton to attend Stanford.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea Clinton to attend Stanford.

text.p: Chelsea Clinton, the daughter of President Bill Clinton, will attend Stanford University in the fall, the White House announced Wednesday.
The long-awaited announcement of where the president's 17-year-old daughter would go to college in a brief written statement.

"The president and Mrs. Clinton announced today that their daughter Chelsea will enter Stanford University this fall as a member of the class of 2001," it said. The Clintons' only child had also considered Harvard, Yale and Princeton.
Stanford, founded in 1891, is in Palo Alto, California, about 35 miles south of San Francisco. No one was immediately available at Stanford to comment on Cheslea's decision.

Hillary Rodham Clinton said on Tuesday night her daughter wanted to pursue a medical career, a course of study for which Stanford is acclaimed. In the United States, students wishing to become physicians take "pre-med" courses as undergraduates before going on to medical school.
